name: manage_team
description: Create and operate a checkpointed agent team with a shared task board. Create a team once, then add, claim, dispatch, advance, complete, message, inspect, or cancel its dependency-aware tasks.

action.description: Operation to perform. create requires name and goal; add_task requires team_id and task; claim requires team_id and member_id; complete requires team_id, task_id, member_id, and status; send_message requires team_id, from, to, and body; all other non-create actions require team_id.

team_id.description: Team UUID returned by create; required for every non-create action.

id.description: Unique member identifier within the team.

agent.description: Optional agent profile name for dispatched work.

model.description: Optional model override for dispatched work.

inherit.description: Context inherited by dispatched work: none, all, cwd, memory, history, skills, or a comma-separated combination. Default cwd,skills.

capabilities.description: Optional capability labels assigned to the member.

budget.description: Optional create-time team limits; omitted fields use their stated defaults.

max_tasks.description: Maximum tasks on the team board. Default 128.

max_total_attempts.description: Total spawn attempts across the team. Default 256; must be >= max_tasks.

id.description: Optional unique task identifier; generated when omitted.

prompt.description: Instructions given to the member that executes the task.

assignee.description: Optional member id restricting who may claim or receive the task.

depends_on.description: Task ids that must complete before this task becomes ready.

task_id.description: Target task id. Optional for claim; required for complete.

member_id.description: Member claiming or completing the task.

lease_secs.description: Claim lease in seconds. Default 300; clamped to 1..=86400.

output.description: Optional successful result recorded by complete.

error.description: Optional failure or cancellation detail recorded by complete.

from.description: Message sender: parent or a member id.

to.description: Message recipient: parent, a member id, or * for broadcast.

reason.description: Optional cancel reason recorded on cancelled tasks. Default team cancelled by parent.

dispatch.description: For advance, dispatch newly ready tasks after collecting terminal work. Default true.
